segments.name: Central
segments.description: Builds and sells entry-level and move-up homes under the LGI Homes and Terrata Homes brands to buyers in Texas, Oklahoma and Minnesota.
segments.evidence: The Midwest division is included in our Central reportable segment and the Mid-Atlantic division is included in our Southeast reportable segment.

segments.name: Southeast
segments.description: Builds and sells new homes to entry-level and active adult buyers in Georgia, Alabama, Tennessee, the Carolinas, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia and West Virginia.
segments.evidence: The Midwest division is included in our Central reportable segment and the Mid-Atlantic division is included in our Southeast reportable segment.

segments.name: Northwest
segments.description: Builds and sells entry-level and move-up homes to buyers in Colorado, Washington and Oregon.
segments.evidence: We have seven operating segments (our Central, Midwest, Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, Northwest, West and Florida divisions) that we aggregate into five qualifying reportable segments at December 31, 2025: our Central, Southeast, Northwest, West, and Florida divisions.

segments.name: West
segments.description: Builds and sells entry-level and luxury homes to buyers in Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, California and Utah.
segments.evidence: We have seven operating segments (our Central, Midwest, Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, Northwest, West and Florida divisions) that we aggregate into five qualifying reportable segments at December 31, 2025: our Central, Southeast, Northwest, West, and Florida divisions.

segments.name: Florida
segments.description: Builds and sells entry-level and active adult homes to buyers across Florida communities.
segments.evidence: We have seven operating segments (our Central, Midwest, Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, Northwest, West and Florida divisions) that we aggregate into five qualifying reportable segments at December 31, 2025: our Central, Southeast, Northwest, West, and Florida divisions.

revenueModel.text: Homebuyers and institutional investors pay the company for the new homes it builds and sells, retail and wholesale.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenues primarily by delivering move-in ready entry-level and move-up spec homes sold under our LGI Homes brand and our luxury series spec homes sold under our Terrata Homes brand.
